items.zh: 一个新的震旦可玩派系
items.en: A new playable Grand Cathay faction

items.zh: 1 名新传奇领主，3 名新传奇英雄，1 种通用领主，1 种通用英雄，10 个新兵种，1 种新法系
items.en: 1 Legendary Lord, 3 Legendary Heroes, 1 generic lord, 1 generic hero, 10 new units, 1 new spell lore

items.zh: 自动搬家一些原版传奇领主到尼朋以及尼朋周边区域（可在 MCT 中关闭）
items.en: Relocates vanilla legendary lords to Nippon and the lands around it (can be switched off in MCT)

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · NRS 兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · Nippon Rising Sun Compatibility Patch

note.zh: [Nippon, Land of the Rising Sun](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3770643554)（NRS）兼容子 mod。可选，两者同时使用时需要。
note.en: [Nippon, Land of the Rising Sun](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3770643554) (NRS) compatibility submod. Optional, needed only when running both mods together.

points.zh: 修复了启动 NRS 时定居点模型不显示，其他派系无法占领定居点等问题
points.en: Fixes settlement models not rendering, and other factions being unable to occupy settlements, while NRS is running

points.zh: 增加了一系列尼朋兵种招募建筑，震旦的派系可以通过任务解锁尼朋系列建筑（玉海舰队默认解锁）
points.en: Adds a series of Nippon unit-recruitment buildings, which Cathay factions can unlock through missions (unlocked by default for the Jade Sea Fleet)

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 震旦机制兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · Cathay Mechanics Compatibility Patch

note.zh: 震旦机制兼容子 mod。已支持：
note.en: Cathay mechanics compatibility submod. Currently supports:

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 溟龙胤隐兵种兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · Yin-Yin Unit Compatibility Patch

note.zh: [溟龙胤隐](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2989226363)兵种兼容子 mod。可选，两者同时使用时需要。
note.en: [Roar of the Jade Sea: Yin-Yin, the Sea Dragon](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2989226363) unit compatibility submod. Optional, needed only when running both mods together.

points.zh: 震旦的派系可以招募胤隐 mod 的兵种
points.en: Cathay factions can recruit the units added by the Yin-Yin mod

points.zh: 玉海舰队的旗舰新增「海贼舱」建筑链
points.en: A new Corsair Berth chain on the Jade Sea Fleet's flagship

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 兵戈天下兵种兼容包
name.en: Nippon Expedition · War under Heaven Unit Compatibility Patch

note.zh: [兵戈天下](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297754796)兵种兼容子 mod。可选，两者同时使用时需要。
note.en: [War under Heaven](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297754796) unit compatibility submod. Optional, needed only when running both mods together.

points.zh: 玉海舰队可以在旗舰上招募卫东列省的特色兵种，开局即可招
points.en: The Jade Sea Fleet can recruit the Eastern Provinces' special units aboard the flagship, from the start of the campaign

name.zh: 远征尼朋 · 周边 AI 强化

note.zh: AI 强化子 mod，可选。对整体 AI 进行了强化，并且对尼朋以及震旦周边的 AI 进行一些特殊强化。
note.en: Stronger AI submod, optional. It strengthens the AI across the whole map, with extra tuning for Nippon and the lands around Cathay.

items.zh: **需要 MIXER 和 IEE 扩展**：[Immortal Empires Expanded](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493) 与 [Mixu's Unlocker](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660)；可选 [Mod Configuration Tool](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021)
items.en: **Requires MIXER and IEE**: [Immortal Empires Expanded](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3007996493) and [Mixu's Unlocker](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859968660); optional [Mod Configuration Tool](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927955021)
